name: Taiga
tagline: A plain, friendly tool for Scrum and Kanban teams
description: A project tool built around agile practice: a backlog of user stories with sprints, a Kanban board, epics, an issue list and a wiki. It deliberately does less than Jira.
backing: Kaleidos (Spain), which also runs the hosted service. Development of this version has slowed in recent years

maturity.rationale: A decade old, stable and widely used, with a hosted service still running. Marked down because development has slowed to maintenance: do not expect new features.

selfHosting.summary: The official taiga-docker repository brings up the back end, front end, events and workers with PostgreSQL and a message broker. That is more containers than the tool's simplicity suggests, all configured through environment variables.

strengths: Easy to learn: a backlog, sprints and a board without Jira's configuration
Built-in importers for Jira, Trello, Asana and GitHub
Fully open source, with no paid edition
weaknesses: Development has slowed to maintenance: few new features in recent years
No Gantt chart, time tracking or configurable workflows

featureNotes.custom-workflows: Custom fields and statuses, without workflow rules
featureNotes.mobile-apps: The web app works on phones
